selector-class-pattern.message: Expected class selector to be kebab-case (BEM `--` modifiers allowed, e.g. .cs-arrow--prev)

color-function-notation.message: Use rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), not rgb(0 0 0 / 55%). The styleCode minifier is documented to fail on a modern function value inside a --x: declaration and then silently serve the last sheet that minified. This CSS is exactly what the copy panel puts in that field.

alpha-value-notation.message: Write the alpha as 0.55, not 55% — same styleCode minifier reason as color-function-notation above.

color-function-alias-notation.message: Write rgba() when there is an alpha, not rgb() with four arguments — a four-argument rgb() is the same CSS Color 4 syntax the styleCode minifier is documented to reject.

unit-disallowed-list.message: Use em, not rem. rem is locked to <html>, and Bootstrap 3 — which the storefronts run — sets `html { font-size: 10px }`, so a rem here ships at 62.5% on a real dealer page. em tracks the host's body size instead.
